animations.name: Light Kick
animations.prompt: time 0-0.4s: Start in the supplied idle guard facing RIGHT. Shift weight onto the supporting leg and lift only the kicking knee, with a short controlled preparation. time 0.4-1s: Execute exactly ONE light kick: the snapping front kick: torso inclines forward, front thigh lifted and lower leg extended forward-right with toes raised, rear leg planted, one arm swept backward and other hand up for balance; keep the entire shoe inside the canvas. Reach the supplied kick keyframe at 1s. time 1-2s: Retract that same leg, bend the knee, replace the foot in its original position and smoothly restore the exact starting idle guard. Keep the planted foot stable, preserve face, outfit, proportions, 16-bit pixel art, 512x512 framing and padding. Fixed camera. One kick and one recovery; no extra strikes, jumps, spins or added effects.
